name: drip-utils
description: Small hooks that make Claude Code sessions easier to follow.

plugins.name: drip-timestamps
plugins.description: Stamps your prompts and Claude's replies with local time, and tells the model when each prompt was sent.

plugins.name: drip-session-title
plugins.description: Names each session after what it is about, without ever making your prompt wait.

plugins.name: drip-guardrails
plugins.description: Safety rails for every tool call: no PR merges or protected-branch pushes, no production writes, reversible deletes only, secrets never read or copied.
